rulings.doorGlow: The little iron door does NOT glow at rest. Author ruling 2026-08-13: 'the door glows only if something is happening.' The glow is an EVENT, not a property of the door. At rest the door is dark green-patinated iron in the boulder wall.
rulings.fireplacePlate: The warm light seeping around the edges of the large riveted iron plate on the far wall is unchanged and still canon — that is the sealed fireplace mouth, not the door.
